description: Pipeline all HNF SLC/SF requests and responses, remove zero-cycle POCQ feedback, add token-safe concurrency and victim handling, then migrate SLCSF to a standalone ClockedObject with lifecycle support.

userStories.title: Extract the synchronous SLC/SF storage backend

userStories.title: Define owned typed SLCSF request messages

userStories.description: As a coherence transaction, I want self-contained responses and versioned lookup snapshots so that delayed completion can be matched and validated safely.
acceptanceCriteria: Define responses containing reqId, pocEntryId, operation kind, terminal status, and an owned operation-specific payload.
Terminal status distinguishes Done, Replay, and unrecoverable Error.
Replay payload contains a reason, absolute retryNotBeforeTick, and redoLookup.
CommitToken contains lookup request ID, line identity, lookup epoch, and SLC/SF hit, set, way, and generation snapshots.

userStories.notes: Interrupted acceptance audit: continue the existing HnfSLCSFResponse.hh and HnfSLCSF.test.cc drafts, but repair them before passing. Response operation identity must cover Lookup plus all 10 concrete mutation operations, not only four broad categories. Replay/Error construction must derive identity from a typed request; do not expose a generic factory that permits arbitrary operation/status/payload mismatches. Test all 11 request-to-response mappings, Done/Replay/Error, redoLookup true and false with absolute retry ticks, every CommitToken field using distinct SLC/SF sentinels, and owned lookup/data/mask/victim/snoop lifetime with no raw pointers or references.

userStories.title: Implement bounded request double buffering and registered credit
userStories.description: As a POCQ client, I want registered request admission so that enqueue cannot form a same-cycle combinational service path or overrun capacity.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement reqIngress and reqReady with promotion only from ingress to ready during an SLCSF wakeup.
tryEnqueue only takes request ownership and returns Accepted, NoCredit, Initializing, or Draining; it performs no probe, policy decision, or persistent mutation.
Enforce reqOutstanding = ingress + ready + in-flight requests without a terminal response and reqOutstanding <= req_queue_entries.
Latch visible request credit once per SLCSF wakeup and immediately decrement it after every Accepted result in that wakeup.
Require req_queue_entries, resp_queue_entries, max_inflight, and every issue width to be positive, and require max_inflight <= req_queue_entries.
RequestNotIssuedInAcceptanceCycle, ReqQueueFullReturnsNoCreditWithoutMutation, and same-wakeup burst-enqueue tests pass.
Rejected requests do not change ownership, persistent state, or request accounting.
Tests pass

userStories.title: Implement response double buffering and terminal reservations
userStories.description: As an SLCSF service, I want reserved response capacity so that every accepted request has exactly one durable terminal completion.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement respPending and respVisible with promotion only from pending to visible during an SLCSF wakeup.
Enforce respOccupied = reserved slots + pending responses + visible responses and respOccupied <= resp_queue_entries.
Reserve a terminal response slot before an operation issues and atomically convert that reservation to respPending on completion.
When no response slot is available, the operation stalls before semantic work or mutation; an operation that has mutated never stalls on response capacity.
Every accepted request produces exactly one Done, Replay, or Error response; a rejected request produces none.
Responses from different pipes may complete out of order and are identified by the pair pocEntryId and reqId rather than global FIFO position.
CompletedResponseNotVisibleUntilNextCycle, AcceptedRequestProducesExactlyOneTerminalResponse, and ResponseBackpressureDoesNotDropOrDuplicate tests pass.
Accounting tests cover reserved, pending, visible, consumed, and full-capacity states.
The four CHI GTest binaries retain all 36 baseline passing tests at the protocol-and-queue stage exit.
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Interrupted acceptance audit recovery is implemented but requires final revalidation before passing. The in-flight entry now owns the terminal reservation and mixed pipes complete out of acceptance order. userStories.title: Implement the non-zero-latency lookup pipeline
userStories.description: As a simulation user, I want lookup to consume configurable service time so that SLC and SF decisions are timing-visible.
acceptanceCriteria: Model L0 Decode, L1 SLC probe, L2 SF probe, L3 policy, and L4 response latch or equivalent observable ready-tick boundaries.
SEQ-hit and SEQ-full decisions may short-circuit at L0 but still take one service cycle and pass through response double buffering.
lookup_latency defaults to 4 child cycles, rejects values below 1 at construction, and uses a defensive minimum of one cycle internally.
For acceptance cycle N and latency L, issueCycle is at least N+1, completeCycle is at least issueCycle+L, and visibleCycle is at least completeCycle+1.
Runtime latency configuration does not rely on a conflicting fixed compile-time pipeline depth.
LookupHasConfiguredLatency, NoZeroCycleLoop, ZeroLatencyConfigurationIsRejected, and exact accepted/issue/complete/visible timestamp tests pass.
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Interrupted acceptance-audit recovery. Preserve the existing timing/accounting and real-backend-result draft, but do not pass or commit it until retryNotBeforeTick is a true absolute gem5 Tick. The current wakeupCycle+1 expression is only a service-local cycle index and becomes a deadline in the past when the simulator tick is nonzero or a child cycle spans multiple ticks. Let wakeup receive or otherwise record an absolute Tick at the completion boundary, make the replay deadline strictly later than that Tick, and drive the SEQ replay test with nonzero absolute wakeup ticks. Retain the real HnfSLCSFBackend::lookup payload, terminal SeqConflict Replay with redoLookup, exact accept/issue/complete/visible cycles, runtime latency coverage, out-of-order mixed-pipe completion, and terminal-reservation accounting.

userStories.title: Preserve lookup semantics and deterministic replacement order
userStories.description: As an HNF maintainer, I want the delayed lookup to return the same facts and replacement behavior as the synchronous baseline.
acceptanceCriteria: Lookup responses preserve hit or miss, state, data, dataDirty, memory-controller decision, snoop mode, opcode, targets, RNF facts, and a CommitToken.
Probe and Replay paths do not modify coherence state, tags, data, sharers, generation, SEQ, or victim storage.
Each successful non-Replay lookup records replacement access exactly once through recordAccess or an equivalent explicit commit point.
Replay records no replacement access, and replacement metadata updates do not change generation.
Four SLC/SF hit-miss combination tests and SeqHitReplayHasNoSideEffects pass.
A deterministic replacement-order regression selects the same victim as the synchronous baseline.

userStories.notes: Interrupted acceptance-audit recovery. Preserve the pure const probe, pre-touch hit/set/way/generation snapshots, single recordAccess commit point, full lookup payload, four hit/miss combinations, and twin-model replacement draft, but do not pass or commit it until lookupEpoch is separated from lookup-access accounting. A normal probe or replacement touch must not advance the global token epoch: US-011 explicitly requires LookupTouchDoesNotInvalidateToken, so an unrelated lookup cannot make an older token stale. Keep a stable nonzero storage/reset epoch in CommitToken and use a separate lookupAccessCount (or equivalent read-only instrumentation) to prove every successful non-Replay lookup records exactly one access and Replay records zero. Rename/add the required SeqHitReplayHasNoSideEffects regression and compare replacement stamps/access count plus generation, semantic facts, SEQ occupancy and full pending-victim identity before and after Replay; generation-only comparison cannot detect an accidental replacement touch. The test draft also references private translation-unit-only SnpOp constants and will not compile; assert through a public opcode contract or stable expected value. Strengthen all four hit/miss cases beyond booleans: cover M/M memory-controller decision, SLC-only data/dirty state, SF-only snoop mode/opcode/targets/RNF facts, and HH state/data/token snapshots, preferably against separately seeded synchronous twins. Retain all US-006 timing, absolute-Tick Replay, reservation, mixed-pipe, and baseline tests.

userStories.title: Add stage-A parameters and HomeNode scheduling
userStories.description: As an HNF configuration author, I want the embedded pipeline driven by the existing HomeNode clock before the standalone SimObject migration.
acceptanceCriteria: HomeNodeFull.py exposes lookup, fill, update, victim, SF-evict, replay, queue, VictimBuffer, issue-width, max-inflight, response-consume-width, and set-lock parameters.
Stage-A defaults are lookup=4, fill=4, update=3, victim=3, SF-evict=2, replay=2 cycles, request and response queues=8, VictimBuffer=2, all widths=1, and max_inflight=1.
HomeNodeFull wakeup advances embedded SLCSF exactly once before linklayer.wakeup.
HomeNode work detection includes ingress, ready, in-flight, pending or visible responses, and CC issue-pending entries.
An idle pipeline does not cause permanent useless self-scheduling.
A default HomeNodeFull instance still configures without caller changes.
A stage-A smoke test proves an accepted lookup completes without another RX flit.

Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Interrupted acceptance-audit recovery. Preserve the drafted stage-A parameter surface, named HomeNodeFullParams-to-HnfSLCSFPipelineConfig mapping, positive-value validation, one slcsf.wakeup(curTick()) call before linklayer.wakeup(), and combined-work self-scheduling, but do not pass or commit until the following gaps are repaired. Use the source-plan HomeNode parameter names with the slcsf_ prefix so this embedded child configuration is unambiguous. The source implementation plan explicitly defines the stage-A/MVP slcsf_enable_set_lock default as False (sections 6 and 9); use false in both HomeNodeFull.py and HnfSLCSFPipelineConfig and assert false in the default regression. If max_inflight > 1 is accepted while the transition flag is false, fail configuration as required by the spec rather than enabling unsafe parallel service. StageASchedulerCompletesLookupWithoutAnotherRxFlit currently loops directly over HnfSLCSF::wakeup and never exercises the HomeNode production scheduling decision, so it would pass even if HomeNode failed to reschedule. Add a testable production scheduling seam or a real HomeNode fixture that follows the same sequence used by HomeNodeFull::wakeup: advance embedded SLCSF exactly once at the absolute Tick, advance the link layer afterward, then decide whether the owner schedules another edge from combined link/CC/SLCSF work. The smoke must enqueue one lookup, provide no further RX flit, follow only that production scheduling result until the response becomes visible, consume it, and prove the next combined-work decision is false so idle scheduling stops. Ensure the actual reschedule path sees SLCSF work; changing only HomeNodeFull::hasLinkWork without using it from the event path is insufficient. Add evidence that a default HomeNode parameter set and at least one non-default Python override reach the exact C++ pipeline config; direct HnfSLCSF defaults alone do not exercise HomeNode configuration. Avoid double SLCSF advancement and retain all prior 63 CHI regressions.

userStories.title: Issue POCQ lookup requests asynchronously
userStories.description: As a POCQ transaction, I want lookup issue separated from completion so that no semantic result is consumed in the request cycle.
acceptanceCriteria: Each CC entry stores current reqId, lookup issue-pending or wait state, a latched response, and CommitToken, with at most one outstanding SLCSF operation per main POCQ entry.
DoSlcLookup only constructs a request and calls tryEnqueue; it performs no synchronous backend lookup and injects no recursive SlcLookupDone.
Accepted requests enter an explicit lookup-wait state.
NoCredit and Initializing preserve graph ownership and retry periodically without duplicate enqueue.
Controller tests use an explicit pump or tick helper rather than synchronous lookup return.
LookupNoCreditEventuallyProgresses and a no-duplicate-issue regression pass.
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Final-iteration preflight. Use one CC-owned SlcSfReqIdAllocator and allocate exactly once per lookup; never reuse LinkLayer sequence IDs or recreate an ID on retry. Add an explicit per-entry lookup phase (None, IssuePending, Waiting, ResponseLatched), current reqId, an owned optional pending SlcSfRequest, optional latched SlcSfResponse, and CommitToken; assert at most one outstanding operation. On first DoSlcLookup, build the owned typed request with pocEntryId, line, requester, opcode/txn kind, QoS, and trace metadata, then call tryEnqueue only. Do not call the synchronous backend lookup, recursively inject SlcLookupDone, or advance the graph from this request cycle. Because rejected rvalue requests remain intact by contract, NoCredit and Initializing must retain the same object and reqId in IssuePending while the graph remains at SlcLookup; periodic service retries only IssuePending entries. Accepted clears the pending request and enters Waiting, and repeated service while Waiting must never enqueue again. Adapt controller tests to an explicit pump ordered as slcsf.wakeup(absoluteTick) followed by cc.serviceInternalWork(). Add LookupNoCreditEventuallyProgresses by prefilling the request queue, proving the reqId stays stable through retries, releasing the blocker, and observing one eventual accepted request/terminal response. Add a no-duplicate regression that repeatedly services a Waiting entry and proves queue/outstanding/response counts remain one. US-010 owns strict response matching, parameterized consume budgets, and full later-cycle graph continuation; implement only the minimum separated response latch/continuation needed to retain US-009 controller liveness, and never complete from DoSlcLookup's request cycle. Preserve existing controller functionality and all prior CHI tests. Stage only the controller implementation/tests and necessary story metadata; leave unrelated working-tree files untouched.

userStories.title: Implement the staged mutation service
userStories.description: As an SLCSF service, I want mutations to have one staged and atomic completion path so that persistent writes cannot be repeated under backpressure.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement U0 Decode and Validate, U1 resource preparation, U2 array write, and U3 invariant check and response latch, or equivalent observable boundaries.

Provide typed Fill, Update, and Evict dispatch for CommitRead, memory fill, maintenance, remove-sharer, and write-line semantics; later stories add flush, SF-victim completion, and dirty-victim release handlers.
U0 failure occurs before reservation consumption and persistent mutation.
U1 acquires every currently required resource atomically; failure cannot leave a partial reservation.
Only U2 modifies persistent storage and checkLineInvariant runs after the write.
U3 atomically converts the pre-held response reservation to respPending.

userStories.notes: Post-commit acceptance recovery for 026d4b8fa1. Multi-resource acquisition is all-or-nothing and leaves no partial lock or reservation on failure.
Done, Replay, Error, drain, and recoverable cancellation each have one testable cleanup point.

Requests needing both lock classes acquire them atomically or in a deadlock-free global order.
Done, Replay, Error, and cancelled pre-commit work release each acquired lock exactly once.
Stalled acquisition retries without leaving a lock or reservation behind.
SameSetOperationsSerialize, LookupAndUpdateSameSetMutuallyExclude, and StalledLockAcquisitionLeaksNoLock pass against the lock and service harness.

calculateNextWakeup chooses the earliest ingress or pending promotion, operation ready tick, initialization deadline, or drain work.
ensureWakeup avoids duplicate events and safely reschedules when earlier work arrives.
